name: Soft-decline / fallback fridge→DHW offer
description: Thin multi-round procedure⇄thermal: first power band min exceeds the fridge condenser max (plant declines), then fallback_power_w retries once at 80–120 W and accepts. on_decline=continue soft-continues if even the fallback declines. Requires SimulatorBackend + ThermalPlant (fridge_condenser_dhw_demo). Continuous re-queue across waits and dedicated wasm UI remain deferred.
